Analysis: Hypothesis 1 is superior because it leverages a target (AEG-1) that has relatively clearer mechanistic underpinnings in HCC and some preclinical grounding, making it more plausible and testable. Although both hypotheses present innovative uses of CRISPR/Cas9 and checkpoint inhibition, the well-characterized role of AEG-1 leads to a more robust framework for evaluating synergy and safety, whereas the lncRNA target in Hypothesis 2 remains less validated. Therefore, hypothesis 1 offers a better balance of novelty, plausibility, testability, and safety.
